# Assignment & Notifications Checklist: 004-task-assignment-notifications

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of HU-10 (task assignment transfer) and HU-11 (internal assignment notifications) — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and scenario/edge coverage
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | Contracts: [assignment-notification-contracts.md](../contracts/assignment-notification-contracts.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are assignment authorization requirements defined for all actor-task states (owner, current responsible after reassignment, non-owner, deleted)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are notification creation requirements defined for every successful assignment and reassignment path with exactly-once semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are read-management requirements defined for both individual mark-as-read and bulk mark-all-as-read, including persistence-after-read semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are audit logging requirements defined with all mandatory fields (actor_id, action, entity_id, timestamp UTC) for every transfer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 - Is the recipient identifier normalization rule (trim spaces, case-insensitive email comparison) explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is "visible in assignee list the same as own tasks" quantified with an explicit attribute list (title, status, due date) and filter/sort parity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the "Asignada a mí" label content unambiguously specified (assignor name vs. email, and which source field provides it)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are self-assignment semantics clearly specified as rejection with informative message versus silent no-op, including audit/notification side effects? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 - Are task visibility transfer rules consistent between FR-005/FR-007 (task leaves assignor list) and acceptance scenario US1-4 (reassignment visibility)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are notification persistence requirements consistent across FR-011, FR-012, SC-005, and the history-model assumption? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are rejection-code requirements consistent between the spec (403/404/400 in US1-3) and the plan/contracts vocabulary (TASK_NOT_FOUND, USER_NOT_FOUND, ASSIGN_TO_SELF, VALIDATION_ERROR)? [Consistency, Spec §US1-3, Plan §3]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the created_by informative-only role (never grants visibility, never mutates) consistently stated across spec Key Entities, plan §1, and data-model §2.1? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, Plan §1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 - Can SC-001 (100% transfer with identical attributes) be objectively measured given the undefined timing window of "next load"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is SC-004 "exactly one notification per successful assignment" measurable for reassignment chains (total 2 notifications, 1 unread for final assignee)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Plan §7]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the triple-negative rejection criteria (no mutation, no TASK_ASSIGNED audit, no notification) in SC-002/SC-007 specified in objectively verifiable form? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is SC-006 filter correctness ("Todas / Creadas por mí / Asignadas a mí") specified with expected per-filter results for a mixed fixture? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are primary-flow requirements complete for discovering a pending notification without scanning the task list under classic server-reload (no async JS)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are reassignment authorization requirements defined for who may reassign (current responsible only, or also original creator)? [Gap, Spec §US1-4, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are recovery requirements defined for orphaned notifications (task logically deleted after notifying) beyond the navigation message? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are alternate origin-filter requirements (absent/invalid ≡ all, combinable with status filter and ordering) documented in the spec or only in plan/contracts? [Coverage, Plan §3, Contracts §5]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are concurrent reassignment requirements (single winner, exactly one audit event plus one notification to the effective assignee) specified with an ordering rule? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are completed-task assignment requirements unambiguous, given the edge-case text both allows transfer and invites the team to block it? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are invalid-email-format versus well-formed-but-unregistered rejection paths distinctly specified (validation vs. lookup failure)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are read idempotency requirements (marking an already-read notification returns success without mutation) defined in the spec? [Gap, Plan §2.2, Contracts §3]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 - Are performance requirements (assignment <200 ms, task list <100 ms, indexed lookups) specified in requirements or only in the plan, and is gating them in scope? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are backend authentication and authorization verification requirements defined for all assignment and notification endpoints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-002]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 - Are atomicity requirements (transfer + audit + notification in a single transaction with total rollback) stated in the spec or only in the plan? [Gap, Plan §4]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are out-of-scope boundaries (single responsible only, no notification delete/expiry, no email/push, no HU-15/HU-16) explicitly excluded in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Exclusiones]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is the assumption "task leaves the assignor list on transfer" validated against US1-1 wording, which states B sees the task but not that A loses it? [Assumption, Spec §US1-1, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the conflict between explicit USER_NOT_FOUND rejection here and potential anti-enumeration neutrality (HU-14) documented and justified in requirements? [Conflict, Plan §5]
